notes.title: Update V1.0.3
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

 Fixed abnormal behavior of the rotation button in the bed dream.
 Added missing wall collision in the doll dream.
 Fixed abnormal behavior when teleporting attached objects.


Optimization:

 Added auto-save before completing a level.
 Added sequence indicators in the table dream.

notes.title: Update V1.0.2
notes.content:
Feature Updates:

 Players can now tap on items from other dreams via the phone to move them into the current dream.
 Added parabolic trajectory for thrown objects.
 Added a display of the last save time on the exit screen.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where the magnet model in the coffin would not disappear after loading a save.
 Fixed a clipping issue with cemetery stones after loading a save.
 Fixed abnormal behavior of the door on the small boat.
 Fixed abnormal behavior when closing menu windows using a key.
 Fixed an issue where fullscreen prompts would not disappear.


Optimization:

 Improved screen display effects in the scene.
 Removed the altar's magnetic effect on held objects and optimized the attraction logic.
 Optimized the hint interface.
